recipes.look: Punchy, saturated slide-film colors with strong contrast and warm tones.
recipes.notes: For when you want colors to pop, especially landscapes; avoid for portraits as skin can look sunburned.

recipes.name: Astia Summer
recipes.look: Vibrant yet softer summery color with warm, pleasant tones and gentle, film-like contrast.
recipes.notes: Good landscape option when Velvia is too strong; may be too vibrant for portraits.

recipes.name: Nostalgic Film
recipes.look: Amber-tinted, vibrant retro rendering evoking faded prints from an old family photo album.
recipes.notes: Retro look; possibly slightly too vibrant and amber for portraits.

recipes.name: Neopan Negative
recipes.look: Contrasty, grainy black-and-white reminiscent of Fujifilm Neopan negative film printed on paper.
recipes.notes: Black-and-white; thrives on high-contrast scenes. Set Monochromatic Color off.

recipes.name: Fujicolor PRO Film
recipes.look: Clean, slightly warm professional negative-film colors with moderate contrast and natural saturation.
recipes.notes: Good general and portrait option; author prefers the Reala Ace version.

recipes.name: Fujicolor PRO 160S
recipes.look: Soft, low-contrast professional portrait negative look with gentle, natural colors and smooth skin.
recipes.notes: Author's favorite of the set for pictures of people.

recipes.name: Reduced Bleach
recipes.look: Desaturated, high-contrast bleach-bypass look with a gritty, moody, cinematic feel to scenes.
recipes.notes: For results distinctly different from the other options; gritty and desaturated.

recipes.name: Monochrome Film
recipes.look: Classic grainy black-and-white film look with solid contrast and deep, rich blacks.
recipes.notes: Thrives in high-contrast light; use the color filter options. Set Monochromatic Color off.

recipes.name: Sepia Print
recipes.look: Warm brown-toned monochrome evoking antique sepia prints from a bygone photographic era.
recipes.notes: Niche option for something different; most will skip it.

recipes.name: Universal Provia

recipes.name: Velvia 100F

recipes.name: Indoor Astia

recipes.name: Elite Chrome

recipes.name: Retro Negative

recipes.name: Fuji Negative

recipes.name: Pulled Negative

recipes.name: Fujicolor Superia 200
recipes.look: Consumer Superia-style negative with nostalgic tones and teal-magenta color contrast throughout.

recipes.name: Americana Film

recipes.name: Eterna Film

recipes.name: Chrome City
